name: Protein-Packed Egg White Veggie Scramble
steps: Sauté the vegetables in oil.
Add the egg whites and scramble; top with feta.

name: Pumpkin Spice Oatmeal with Pecans
steps: Simmer the oats with the milk, pumpkin and spice.
Top with pecans.

name: Smoked Salmon and Avocado Egg Cups
steps: Fill muffin cups with salmon, avocado and cream cheese.
Pour in the eggs and bake at 350°F for 16 minutes; finish with chives.

name: Whole Grain Toast with Cottage Cheese and Tomato
steps: Toast the bread and top with cottage cheese, tomato, basil and pepper.

name: Turkey Sausage Egg and Cheese Breakfast Bites
steps: Brown and crumble the sausage.
Mix with the eggs, milk, cheddar and spinach and bake in mini muffin cups at 350°F for 18 minutes.

name: Coconut Chia Breakfast Pudding with Mango
steps: Whisk the chia, coconut milk, vanilla and sweetener; chill 4 hours.
Top with mango.

name: Banana Almond Butter Toast
steps: Toast the bread and spread with almond butter.
Top with banana, chia and cinnamon.

name: Southwest Egg Skillet with Sweet Potato and Black Beans
steps: Soften the diced sweet potato, pepper and onion in oil with cumin.
Add the beans, make wells and cook the eggs in them covered 6 minutes.

name: Cinnamon Apple Protein Pancakes
steps: Whisk the eggs and yogurt, fold in the oat flour, protein, cinnamon, baking powder and grated apple.
Cook small pancakes.

name: Spinach and Gruyere-Style Breakfast Strata
steps: Layer the cubed bread, spinach, onion and Swiss in a dish.
Pour over the eggs and milk and bake at 350°F for 35 minutes.

name: Lemon Ricotta Pancakes
steps: Whisk the ricotta, eggs and lemon.
Fold in the oat flour and baking powder; cook small pancakes and top with blueberries.

name: Egg and Black Bean Breakfast Tostadas
steps: Crisp the tortillas in the oven.
Top with warm beans, fried eggs, avocado, salsa and cotija.

name: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken with Zucchini Ribbons
steps: Marinate the chicken in lemon, thyme, garlic and oil; grill.
Sauté the zucchini ribbons briefly and top with parmesan.

name: Chicken and Vegetable Kebabs with Tzatziki
steps: Skewer the marinated chicken with the vegetables and grill.
Serve with yogurt mixed with grated cucumber.

name: Sheet Pan Turkey Sausage with Broccoli and Sweet Potato
steps: Toss everything with oil and garlic powder on a tray.
Roast at 425°F for 25 to 28 minutes.

name: Chicken Cutlets with Arugula Tomato Salad
steps: Coat the pounded chicken in egg then almond flour and parmesan and pan-fry in half the oil.
Toss the arugula and tomatoes with lemon and remaining oil and pile on top.

name: Peanut Chicken Skewers with Cucumber Salad
steps: Marinate the chicken in peanut butter, soy sauce, lime and ginger and grill on skewers.
Toss the cucumber and onion with vinegar.

name: Mediterranean Turkey Burgers with Tzatziki
steps: Mix the turkey with feta, oregano and garlic and shape patties; grill.
Serve on lettuce with tomato and cucumber yogurt.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Taco Soup
steps: Combine everything in the slow cooker.
Cook on low 6 hours and shred the chicken.

name: Turkey and Sweet Potato Chili
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion and garlic.
Add the spices, sweet potato, beans, tomatoes and broth and simmer 30 minutes.

name: Roasted Garlic Cauliflower Soup
steps: Roast the cauliflower and garlic with the oil at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Blend with the broth and milk.

name: Spring Vegetable and Chicken Soup
steps: Simmer the chicken, carrot and leek in the broth 18 minutes; shred the chicken.
Add the asparagus and peas for 5 minutes and finish with dill and lemon.

name: Italian White Bean and Tuna Soup
steps: Soften the garlic in oil, add the broth, beans and tomatoes and simmer 12 minutes.
Fold in the tuna and spinach.

name: Lemon Garlic Baked Tilapia with Roasted Broccoli
steps: Bake the tilapia with garlic butter and lemon at 400°F for 14 minutes.
Roast the broccoli alongside.

name: Salmon and Vegetable Foil Packets
steps: Seal the salmon and vegetables with oil, lemon and dill in foil packets.
Bake at 400°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Tuna Steak Tacos with Mango Salsa
steps: Sear the tuna 90 seconds a side and slice.
Mix the mango, onion, lime, cilantro and jalapeno.
Serve in warm tortillas.

name: Cajun Catfish Bowls with Cauliflower Rice
steps: Season and sear the catfish.
Sauté the pepper and cauliflower rice in oil.
Serve topped with fish, green onion and lemon.

name: Seared Scallops with Lemon Spinach
steps: Sear the dried scallops in butter 2 minutes a side.
Wilt the spinach with garlic and lemon and serve under the scallops.

name: Crispy Baked Shrimp with Cocktail Sauce
steps: Dip the shrimp in egg then almond flour, parmesan and paprika and bake on a tray at 425°F for 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir the paste with lemon for a quick cocktail sauce.

name: Chickpea and Spinach Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
steps: Bake the sweet potatoes.
Sauté the chickpeas and spinach with cumin and garlic.
Fill the potatoes and drizzle with lemon tahini.

name: Tofu Veggie Fried Rice, Brown Rice
steps: Brown the tofu, add the vegetables and garlic, scramble in the egg.
Add the cold rice, soy sauce and sesame oil.

name: Mushroom and Spinach Stuffed Zucchini Boats
steps: Scoop the zucchini and sauté the flesh with the mushrooms, spinach and garlic.
Mix with ricotta, fill the boats, top with parmesan and bake at 400°F for 22 minutes.

name: Three-Bean Salad Bowls with Quinoa
steps: Toss the beans, quinoa, onion and pepper with vinegar and oil.
Chill 30 minutes.

name: Roasted Vegetable Frittata Cups
steps: Divide the vegetables among muffin cups.
Pour in the beaten eggs and parmesan and bake at 375°F for 22 minutes.

name: Black Bean Quinoa Burrito Bowls
steps: Warm the quinoa, beans and corn.
Top with avocado, salsa, lime and cilantro.
